profile.headline: Software Engineer at Juniper Networks
profile.summary:
Skills : 
• Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, NoSQL, Bash
• Spring framework, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Angular, JQuery, IOS/Android Development, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Solr, Hadoop, MapReduce, HBase, AWS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, RESTful, Microservices, Docker, Eureka, AWS, Hystrix, JWT, Linux, Unix

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: At Juniper Networks (Mist Systems, now part of HPE), I spearheaded the development of distributed cloud services that support AI-driven enterprise networking. My role involved optimizing data pipelines to enhance performance and implementing observability tools that significantly improved incident resolution times. Collaborating closely with product managers and SREs, I ensured our Kubernetes maintained exceptional uptime across global deployments.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: At Hitachi Vantara, I played a pivotal role in developing an enterprise computing platform that streamlined Kubernetes cluster operations across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. My responsibilities included designing microservices with Node.js, gPRC, and enhancing system performance through rigorous R&D on Kubernetes applications. This experience honed my skills in full-stack development and cloud technologies.
